## FSM Path-Based Test Suite for U18_GUI

**States:**

* `START`
* `SET_PIP`
* `SET_RISE_TIME`
* `SET_RISE_PARAMETER`
* `SET_MODE`
* `DETECT_SHUTDOWN`
* `DISPLAY_FIO2`

**Transitions:**

* `START` -> `SET_PIP` (user selects PIP)
* `SET_PIP` -> `SET_RISE_TIME` (user sets rise time)
* `SET_RISE_TIME` -> `SET_RISE_PARAMETER` (user sets rise parameter)
* `SET_RISE_PARAMETER` -> `SET_MODE` (user selects mode)
* `SET_MODE` -> `DETECT_SHUTDOWN` (controller shuts down)
* `DETECT_SHUTDOWN` -> `DISPLAY_FIO2` (GUI displays FiO2)

**Test Cases:**

**TC-001:** Positive - Set PIP, Rise Time, Rise Parameter, Mode

```json
{
  "id": "TC-001",
  "title": "Set PIP, Rise Time, Rise Parameter, Mode",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-99", "RW-SW-139", "RW-SW-141", "RW-SW-155"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": [],
  "inputs": {"pip": 20, "rise_time": 2, "rise_parameter": 5, "mode": "pressure controlled ventilation"},
  "steps": [],
  "expected": ["PIP set to 20 cmH2O", "Rise time set to 2 seconds", "Rise parameter set to 5%", "Mode set to pressure controlled ventilation"]
}
```
